The stock market indices of the app

Source: R/fct_data.R
get_indices.Rd

The major indices of the US, Europe and Asia, and the VIX, with their symbols on Yahoo Finance. The label column holds the names, such as "S&P 500", that pick indices in get_history().

Usage

get_indices()

Value

A data frame with a row per index: label, symbol on Yahoo Finance, region ("US", "Europe" or "Asia") and the currency of the shares in it. The VIX is a measure of the expected volatility of the S&P 500, in percent a year, so its currency is NA.

Examples

get_indices()
#>               label    symbol region currency
#> 1           S&P 500     ^GSPC     US      USD
#> 2         Dow Jones      ^DJI     US      USD
#> 3  Nasdaq Composite     ^IXIC     US      USD
#> 4      Russell 2000      ^RUT     US      USD
#> 5     Euro Stoxx 50 ^STOXX50E Europe      EUR
#> 6          FTSE 100     ^FTSE Europe      GBP
#> 7               DAX    ^GDAXI Europe      EUR
#> 8            CAC 40     ^FCHI Europe      EUR
#> 9    Athens General     GD.AT Europe      EUR
#> 10       Nikkei 225     ^N225   Asia      JPY
#> 11        Hang Seng      ^HSI   Asia      HKD
#> 12              VIX      ^VIX     US     <NA>
